handsFree.label: Hands-free mode
handsFree.help: Say "Voco", then your message, and end it with "over": it is sent after 3 seconds, and saying "cancel" in that time recalls it. A message that ends like a command ("…fix it") is also sent after a short pause and countdown; speaking again or a tap stops it. A dictation you start by tapping the microphone is read back briefly and sent when you say "yes" or "send"; an unclear answer keeps the text in the box unsent. A pending decision for a safe command is read out and answered with "allow" or "deny", and decisions in other sessions are announced. Caution and dangerous commands, and options such as "don't ask again", must be confirmed on screen. A tap anywhere stops the voice.

handsFree.voco.label: Wake word "Voco"
handsFree.voco.help: Say "Voco" to start a message; the app answers "Yes?" with a short chime and writes what you say into the box. End with "over" or "send it over" (or, after a short pause, "send it"): the message is sent and you have 3 seconds to say "cancel". "Cancel" discards the message, "again" starts over, "Voco, session 3" switches the session and "Voco, status" plays the briefing. Before the wake word only a short piece of each utterance is checked for it; nothing else is kept or sent.

settings.micAnimation.light-drop.desc: The lights fall from above and settle with a small bounce, in a mixed order for rhythm.
settings.micAnimation.light-particles.de: Hundreds of specks of light gather from the rim, fill the strokes and harden into the logo.
settings.micAnimation.light-sides.desc: Five lights fly in from five directions at once and lock together. The clearest assembly.
settings.micAnimation.light-rise.desc: The lights shoot up from the bottom and lock in one by one, with a sense of lift.
settings.micAnimation.light-swoosh.desc: The lights stretch out, sweep in from the left and stop in place.
settings.micAnimation.light-spiral.desc: The lights circle around, wind inward and stand upright.
settings.micAnimation.light-burst.desc: Light bursts from the center, scatters, then is pulled back in to form the logo.
settings.micAnimation.light-scan.desc: A bright beam sweeps from top to bottom and engraves the logo. The calmest style.
settings.micAnimation.stroke-amplitude.d: Each stroke grows and shrinks to its own beat, like on the landing page.
settings.micAnimation.stroke-voice.desc: Stroke heights follow how loud you speak; the center stroke reacts most.
settings.micAnimation.stroke-wave.desc: The strokes rise in turn from the left, like a passing wave.
settings.micAnimation.stroke-center.desc: The middle stroke leads and the outer pairs follow, like speech spreading out.
settings.micAnimation.stroke-flow.desc: A bright cyan band keeps flowing up through the strokes.
settings.micAnimation.stroke-glow.desc: The symbol shines brighter and grows slightly as you speak.
settings.micAnimation.stroke-writing.des: The outlines draw themselves like a pen, then fill in, over and over.
settings.micAnimation.stroke-echo.desc: Copies of the symbol spread outward and fade.
settings.micAnimation.stroke-spread.desc: The strokes fan apart while you speak, wider when louder, and gather again at the end.
settings.micAnimation.stroke-ring.desc: The symbol stays still while a ring of short bars around it reaches out with the sound.

security.remoteShellHelp: Lets paired phones open a terminal on this PC. Turning it on asks for verification.
security.graceHelp: One verification covers the steps of a single task for this long, for example setting up the authenticator or a recovery. Connecting a phone or approving a device always asks.
security.stepUp.title: Verify it's you
security.stepUp.why: This action needs a check on this PC.
security.stepUp.macLocalAuth: Verify with Touch ID or password
security.stepUp.noOsVerifier: This PC has no Windows Hello or Touch ID, so the authenticator code is used.
security.stepUp.codeNeeded: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
security.error.totp_replayed: This code was just used. Wait for the next one.
security.error.remote_shell_open: Close the remote shells first: on this PC a code decides, and a remote shell could type one.
engines.field.allowPlainHttp: Allow plain http on my private network
engines.field.allowPlainHttpHelp: The key travels unencrypted. Anyone on this network can read it. Without this, a saved key is not sent here. Turning it on asks for verification on this PC.
security.reason.engine_url: Send a saved engine key to a new address
security.stepUp.firstRun: This PC has no Windows Hello or Touch ID and no authenticator yet, so it cannot check who you are. Continue only if you started this yourself.
security.error.presence_required: This first setup must be started by a person at this PC, not from a session.
security.mail.currentCodeNeeded: Changing how mail is sent needs a code from your authenticator app, or a backup code.
pairing.confirmHelp: Your PC shows a code next to the QR code. It must be exactly this one. If it differs, this link is not from your PC: do not enter any code.
pairing.confirmCheck: My PC shows the same code
pairing.confirmFirst: Check the confirm code first: it must match the one on your PC.
host.confirmCodeHelp: The phone shows a code too. Pair only if both are the same.
composer.decisionOpen: The agent is waiting for a decision. Answer it first; your text stays here.
security.error.verification_unavailable: This PC cannot verify you yet. Set up an authenticator app first.
security.error.totp_required: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
security.error.totp_invalid: That code is not correct. Try again.
security.error.conflict: The authenticator state has changed. Reopen this screen and try again.
security.error.current_code_required: Enter a code from your current authenticator app too.
security.error.recipient_domains: This address is not allowed. Allowed domains: {domains}
security.error.mail_not_configured: Mail is not set up yet.
security.error.mail_failed: The mail could not be sent: {reason}
security.error.rate_limited: Too many tries. Wait a moment and try again.
security.error.code_expired: That code has expired. Start again.
security.error.attempts_exceeded: Too many wrong codes. Start again.
security.error.unreachable: The server on this PC is not running.
security.mail.intro: Get a mail when something important happens to your security.
security.mail.recipientsHelp: Up to 5 addresses, separated by commas.
security.mail.recipientsHelpDomains: Up to 5 addresses, separated by commas. Allowed domains: {domains}
security.recovery.howMail: Verify on this PC, then enter the 6-digit code we mail you.
security.recovery.howBackup: Verify on this PC, then enter one of your backup codes.
security.recovery.noMailUseBackup: Mail is not set up. Use a backup code instead.
security.recovery.verified: Verified. Set up your new authenticator now.
security.recovery.done: Your new authenticator is set up.
security.recovery.notEnrolled: No authenticator is set up yet, so there is nothing to recover.
security.wizard.title: Protect this PC
security.wizard.verifyIntro: Important changes will ask you to verify on this PC. Try it once.
security.wizard.verifyNone: This PC has no Windows Hello or Touch ID. The authenticator code will be used instead.
security.wizard.verifyUnavailable: {name} is not ready on this PC. The authenticator code will be used instead.
security.wizard.totpIntro: Add this PC to an authenticator app. Phones need its code to connect.
security.wizard.mailIntro: With mail you get alerts, and can recover a lost authenticator with a mailed code.
security.wizard.summaryIncomplete: Setup is not finished yet. You can finish it later.
security.wizard.summaryWhere: You can change these in Settings, under Security.
security.banner.text: 2-step verification is not set up yet.
cc.title: Command Center
cc.shell.hint: A remote shell in a project folder you choose
cc.shell.pickFirst: Choose a project folder with Change folder to open a shell there.
cc.shell.conductorFolder: This is the conductor’s own folder. Choose a project folder instead.
cc.shell.pickerUnsupported: This PC cannot list folders. Update VCA on the PC to choose another folder.
cc.hooksMissing.title: The conductor's replies can't be read.
cc.hooksMissing.fixLocal: Its agent never reported back to VCA: the VCA hooks are missing from the agent's settings (another tool may have rewritten them). Repair them in Settings › Alerts › Agent connection, then start the conductor again.
cc.hooksMissing.fixRemote: Its agent never reported back to VCA: the VCA hooks are missing on the PC. Repair them in the PC app's Settings › Alerts › Agent connection, or run `vca hooks install` there.
cc.stopped.off: The conductor is stopped. Its earlier conversation stays below.
cc.stopped.revoked: The kill switch stopped the conductor. Starting it again needs your confirmation on the PC.
cc.stopped.remote: Start it again in the desktop app on the PC.
cc.inbox.help: What the Command Center raised for you: other sessions' decisions it could not settle within your rules (with its summary), its own decisions and requests, and to-dos it waits on. The original alerts stay under Alerts. Answers go through the same checks as on the session screen.
cc.inbox.kind.question: Question
cc.log.answerApprove: Approved a decision of {session} under your rule “{rule}”.
cc.log.answerDeny: Declined a decision of {session} under your rule “{rule}”.
cc.log.escalated: Raised a decision of {session} to your approvals: “{text}”.
cc.log.escalatedNoText: Raised a decision of {session} to your approvals.
cc.log.escalatedFallback: A decision of {session} went to your approvals by itself.
cc.inbox.escalation.fallbackTimeout: The Command Center did not handle this in time, so it came straight to you.
cc.inbox.escalation.fallbackStopped: The Command Center is stopped, so this came straight to you.
cc.inbox.escalation.fallbackPaused: The Command Center is paused, so this came straight to you.
cc.inbox.escalation.fallbackRevoked: The Command Center was stopped with the kill switch, so this came straight to you.
cc.inbox.escalation.fallbackProblem: The Command Center cannot work right now, so this came straight to you.
cc.inbox.escalation.fallbackNotRouted: Passing events to the Command Center is off, so this came straight to you.
cc.control.talkHint: What you say goes into the conductor's box for review; nothing is sent on its own.
cc.control.handsFreeHint: Hands-free: in the conversation, say “Voco …, over” to the conductor.
cc.control.pauseHelp: Stops the conductor and its pending requests. You can start it again any time on the PC.
cc.control.resumeHelp: Asks for your confirmation on this PC.
cc.log.title: What the conductor did
cc.log.unavailable: This device cannot read the activity log.
cc.log.sentAllowedNoText: Sent a message to {session} (you allowed it).
cc.log.sentInstruction: Auto-approved by your instruction: sent “{text}” to {session}.
cc.log.sentInstructionNoText: Auto-approved by your instruction: sent a message to {session}.
cc.log.grant: Your instruction: checked sends to {sessions} are auto-approved for this turn (up to {minutes} min).
cc.log.grantAll: Your instruction: checked sends to every session are auto-approved for this turn (up to {minutes} min).
cc.log.denied: Did not send “{text}” to {session}: it was denied.
cc.log.deniedNoText: Did not send a message to {session}: it was denied.
cc.log.timedOut: Did not send “{text}” to {session}: nobody answered in time.
cc.log.timedOutNoText: Did not send a message to {session}: nobody answered in time.
cc.log.wakeNoText: Passed new events to the conductor.
cc.log.kill: The kill switch stopped the conductor.
cc.log.settingsOn: Conductor settings saved ({agent}, at most {max} actions an hour).
cc.log.settingsOff: The conductor was turned off in Settings.
cc.log.allowAdd: Sends to {session} need no confirmation for {minutes} min.
cc.log.noReply: A conductor turn ended without a reply you could see.
cc.control.pauseCcHelp: Nothing wakes the conductor until you resume it; its session keeps running and still takes your instructions. Resume any time, here or on a phone.
cc.control.stopHelp: Ends the conductor's session and denies its pending requests. Starting it again needs your confirmation on the PC.
cc.paused: The Command Center is paused: nothing wakes the conductor until you resume it. You can still talk to it.
cc.turnStalled.title: The conductor's last turn hasn't finished for 15 minutes.
cc.turnStalled.fixLocal: It may be stuck. Check its terminal, or choose Stop conductor in the header's “Pause or kill switch” menu and start it again here.
cc.turnStalled.fixRemote: It may be stuck. Choose Stop conductor in the header's “Pause or kill switch” menu, then start it again in the desktop app on the PC.
cc.kill.codeDescription: Stops the conductor, denies its pending requests and revokes its tools. A phone can be lost, so the kill switch needs the code from your authenticator app.
cc.kill.error.totp_required: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
cc.kill.error.totp_invalid: That code is wrong or was already used. Wait for the next code and try again.
cc.kill.error.forbidden: Too many wrong codes. Wait a few minutes and try again, or use the kill switch on the PC.
cc.kill.error.unsupported: No authenticator app is set up on the PC, so the kill switch can't be used from a phone. Use it on the PC, or set up 2-step verification there first.
cc.kill.error.unavailable: The PC's security service is off, so the code can't be checked. Use the kill switch on the PC.
cc.log.killRefused: A kill switch request was refused: the authenticator code was missing or wrong.
cc.log.noReplyHooks: A conductor turn ended without a reply you could see; the VCA hooks may be missing.
appLock.lockedHelp: Unlock with this device's sign-in to see your sessions.
appLock.codeHelp: This PC has no Windows Hello or Touch ID. Enter the code from your authenticator app.
appLock.unprotected: This device has nothing to verify you with (no Windows Hello, Touch ID, Face ID, fingerprint, passcode or authenticator app), so anyone holding it can open the app. Set one of them up to protect your sessions.
appLock.serverDown: The VCA server on this PC is not running. It checks Windows Hello or Touch ID, so the app stays locked until it runs.
appLock.startServer: Start the server and try again
appLock.cannotStart: This app cannot start the server. Start it on this PC (vca daemon), then unlock again.
appLock.commandHelp: The Command Center can act on every session, so it asks again when the last unlock is more than 5 minutes old.
appLock.settings.title: App lock
appLock.settings.help: The app opens locked and locks again when it is not used or stays in the background. It unlocks with this device's sign-in: Windows Hello, Touch ID, Face ID, fingerprint or the device passcode. Alerts still arrive as notifications, without their content.
appLock.settings.commandNote: The Command Center always asks for a new unlock when the last one is more than 5 minutes old, even with the app lock off.
live.bringToFront: Bring the PC window to front
composer.disabledExitedNoReopen: This session has ended and cannot be reopened from VCA. Use Remove from VCA above to clear it.
ended.title: Ended session
ended.shell: This remote shell has closed (idle or time limit, or it was closed). Reopen starts a new shell in the same folder.
ended.observed: This session ran in a terminal window on the PC, so VCA cannot reopen it. Start it again on the PC, or remove it from VCA.
remove.title: Remove “{name}” from VCA?
remove.stopBody: The agent is still running. Removing it stops the agent process now and takes the session off the list on every device. The conversation history and the project folder stay on the PC, and you can start a new session in that folder at any time.
remove.endedBody: The session has ended. Removing it takes it off the list on every device. The conversation history and the project folder stay on the PC.
remove.pcWindowTitle: Close it on the PC first
remove.pcWindowBody: “{name}” runs in a terminal window on the PC, so VCA cannot stop it. Close that terminal window on the PC (or exit the agent there). Once the session has ended, use Remove from VCA again.
remove.cloudBody: “{name}” runs at {provider}. Stop it first with Stop in the session view. Once the session has ended, use Remove from VCA again.
remove.conductorBody: This is the conductor’s own session. Stop the conductor in its view; its session then ends.
windows.restoreVcaNote: Sessions started in VCA have no window on the PC, so they are not listed here. To remove one, use Remove from VCA in its menu in the session list, or in the Session order tab.
ended.closingSoon: {name} closes in {time} because it is idle.
ended.closingFinal: {name} reaches its maximum open time and closes in {time}. Save your work; you can open a new shell afterwards.
switcher.title: Switch session
switcher.hint: Type to search. Arrow keys move through the list; Enter opens the session.
sendTo.title: Send to session
sendTo.search: Search the session to send to
sendTo.draftHint: The text goes into the message box of {name}, where you can edit it and send it yourself.
sendTo.confirmBody: This text is sent to {name} right away, as if typed in its message box.
sendTo.draftToast: Added to the message box of {name}
sendTo.blocked.gone: That session is no longer on the list.
sendTo.blocked.empty: There is no text to send.
sendTo.blocked.exited: {name} has ended and takes no input.
sendTo.blocked.observe: {name} runs in a terminal on the PC and can only be watched from VCA.
sendTo.blocked.decision: {name} is waiting for an answer to a question. Answer it in that session first; the text can still go into its message box.
sendTo.blocked.shell: A remote shell only takes one command line at a time, confirmed in its sheet. Put the text into the message box of {name} instead.
mention.remove: Remove {name} as the target (send to {current} instead)
mention.noAttachments: Attachments only go to this session. Remove them, or the @{name} target, before sending.
mention.voiceBlocked: Messages to another session (@{name}) are sent by hand, not by voice. Tap Send to send it.
shellTab.hint: A remote shell in this session’s project folder
shellTab.limits: It asks for your authenticator code, and closes by itself when idle or after its time limit. The time left shows here.
terminal.fitHint: Fit the terminal to the screen width
reading.hint: Hides the bars so the chat fills the screen. A double tap on empty chat space also switches it.
